messages:
incident-bot: Pager: svc=inference-serve region=sam-north1 severity=page — 5xx spike > 8% over 3m, p50 latency increase. Paged oncall: @emily-w.

emily-w: I'm on it. seeing increased 502/504s from edge -> egress NAT in sam-north1. dashboard: https://internal.redwood/ops/d/serve?region=sam-n1 (watching).

emily-w: initial hypothesis: peering egress instability with local ISP + packet drops causing backend connections to time out.

raj-n: tagging in — network team looking. BGP events from the region's colo for the last 20m (flapping routes). Confirming with peering partner.

marcos-s: I'm on-site for SA ops. Quick check: node health mostly green, but NAT gateway CPU is pegged on a subset of hosts. Could be SNAT connection table exhaustion.

emily-w: ok if NAT conn table is the culprit, we should reroute traffic away from sam-n1 for customer-facing routes and fail to standby regional variants. Let's prepare traffic-shift command.

emily-w: Draft command to shift: 
```
# divert inference traffic off sam-north1 to west-us2  (gradual)
redwoodctl traffic shift --from-region sam-north1 --to-region west-us2 --percent 50 --purpose emergency
```

emily-w: starting 50% test diversion in 2m unless objections.

raj-n: +1. We'll also request peering partner escalate. I'll open a ticket and paste ASN trace.

katherine-c: Support here. Should we prep customer status text? I can blast a customer advisory if we confirm impact >= some threshold.

emily-w: Yes, please draft a short status page + customer email. Minimal but clear. Include affected regions list and recommended workaround (use global endpoint which will route to other regions automatically).

sasha-p: Handoff note — I'm taking the next 1hr after emily if this remains hot.

emily-w: Executing shift now. Running in canary mode (50%). Monitoring error rate and tail latencies.

incident-bot: Action logged: traffic.shift started by emily-w at 2143658810. Task ID tsk_9a3f.

marcos-s: After the shift, errors on sam-n1 dropped from 9% -> 4% within 90s. West-us2 saw a small latency bump (+30ms p95) but no error increase. Good sign.

raj-n: Peering partner responded: they saw intermittent NAT session exhaustion due to upstream ACL misbehavior; they are rolling config change now. ETA 25-40m for stable routing.

emily-w: Recommended status page update (please edit & publish):

"We are investigating elevated errors for inference requests routed through the South America (sam-north1) region. Traffic has been partially diverted to alternate regions to reduce customer impact. Root cause appears related to upstream egress/NAT instability. We will provide updates as we confirm mitigation steps and restoration timeline."

katherine-c: Customer advisory draft for affected customers:

"We are actively mitigating an increased error rate impacting requests routed through our South America (sam-north1) region. We have temporarily diverted traffic to alternate regions to reduce impact. No action required for customers using the global endpoint. If you have pinned a region via configuration and need immediate assistance, reply to this message or contact support@redwood.io and we will help re-route your traffic."

emily-w: Internal comms template: short bullets for account managers / CSMs:
- Affected region: sam-north1
- Impact: intermittent 502/504s, elevated error rate, partial request diversion implemented
- Mitigation: 50% traffic shift -> increased to 100% if error rate doesn't drop below 1.5% in 15m
- ETA for upstream fix: 25-40m (partner reported config change rolling)
- Next update: in 15m or on status change

marcos-s: Suggest adding note about customers with pinned model versions in sam-n1 — they may see longer failover. We can assist with temporary model pin override to west-us2.

emily-w: Making that explicit in the customer note: "If you have model pinning to sam-north1, contact support to request an override to a nearby region."

incident-bot: Monitor rule: error_rate(sam-north1) now 3.8% at 2143659000 (down from 9%).

raj-n: Partner reports routing stable on a subset of routers; rolling change 50% -> 100% in 20m. We'll keep BGP adjacency watchers on.

emily-w: Planning next step: if error < 2% after 15m, keep shift at 50% and publish initial status page + customer advisory. If error still >2% escalate to 100% diversion and raise SE-urgent.

katherine-c: Published initial status page update and queued customer advisory draft. Link: https://status.redwood.io/incidents/2143658700-sam-n1 (draft posted).

sasha-p: Taking over monitoring in 15m. Leaving runbook and commands in the thread. If I see error creep + traffic shift still high, I'll increase to 100% and notify @raj-n and @marcos-s.

emily-w: Handing off to @sasha-p now. Leaving logs and command history in casebook.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: emily-w -> sasha-p at 2143659475.

sasha-p: Acknowledged. Monitoring. I'll post a final wrap when incident is resolved or when control changes. :white_check_mark:
